name: Hell in the Sheets
source:
You've come to the island of Hawai'i on vacation in an attempt to find yourself. As you're contemplating and stargazing, a Hellhound Femboy approaches you and changes your life...

Hell in the Sheets is an adult visual novel featuring a monster boy dungeon master, Taylor, who wants to get you into the sheets and the "sheets". Enjoy a game-within-a-game as Taylor runs your very first tabletop roleplaying game before he shows you that his tongue isn't just for making funny voices~

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/hell-in-the-sheets]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你来到夏威夷岛度假，试图寻找自我。当你沉思和仰望星空时，地狱猎犬女男孩接近你并改变你的生活……

《床单地狱》是一部成人视觉小说，主角是怪物男孩地下城主泰勒，他想让你进入床单和“床单”。享受游戏中的游戏，泰勒将运行你的第一个桌面角色扮演游戏，然后他向你展示他的舌头不仅仅是用来发出有趣的声音~

[来自[url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/hell-in-the-sheets]itch.io[/url]]
